title: Lag-1 exact subset recurrence tilt
hypothesis: The immediately previous draw may alter the probability of the next 5-number subset through a common recurrence/avoidance tilt, beyond the exact uniform 5/40 null. A positive beta favors repeats; a negative beta favors avoidance.

definition.alternative: P_beta(D_t | D_(t-1)) proportional to exp(beta * K_t) over all 658008 5-subsets

models.M0: Uniform over all 5-subsets; exact null beta=0.
models.selection: Select beta maximizing mean exact subset log-likelihood gain on Validation only; ties prefer beta nearest zero. No selection on Blind OOS.

walk_forward.cutoff_rule: For target index t, use only D_(t-1) as the state. The target D_t is scored after its forecast distribution is fixed. No target or later draw enters the forecast.
walk_forward.interpretation: Historical Blind OOS is not a virgin holdout because prior SONAR research has repeatedly inspected this archive.

endpoints.primary: Exact subset log-likelihood gain versus uniform, positive favors M1.
endpoints.secondary: Multiclass Brier gain for the six-category overlap PMF q_beta versus q0, positive favors M1.

inference.method: Circular block sign-flip on paired per-target gains

endpoints.multiple_testing: Holm across the two selected-model Blind OOS endpoints; separately report Holm across the eight nonzero beta-grid primary log-score tests on Blind OOS.

guardrails: No future target or future draw is used to construct any forecast.
Validation alone selects beta; Blind OOS is not used for tuning.
All 658008 five-number subsets are represented by the exact overlap normalizer.
No subgroup search or post-hoc beta-grid expansion.
Historical Blind OOS is exploratory, not an independent prospective holdout.
No production engine change, no promotion, no automatic merge.
decision_rule: Demonstrate incremental lift only if the selected beta is nonzero, its Blind OOS primary gain is positive, the one-sided block test remains significant after Holm correction across the two preregistered endpoints, and independent prospective evidence is subsequently accumulated.
